set.body:
Scope: ScalaFIM and mesh4s dependency pins/overrides; affected provider consumers.

Deliverable: Align the coordinate provider graph and migrate all consumers to the shared types; update the spatial-transform ADR at this accepted cutover.

Acceptance:
- Transitive resolution contains a single admitted spatial4s/locus4s/Ravel type authority.
- Provider composition and ScalaFIM transform oracle suites pass against the exact revision set.
- No stale frame wrappers or implicit conversion path remain; local development overrides are explicit.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U2: Integrate one coherent coordinate provider revision set
